index.title: IIEST Student Wiki
index.lede: A comprehensive guide to IIEST Shibpur and knowledge transfer.
index.html:
This college is old, really old. And like many older institutions, essential information is scattered and locked away in the heads of a few individuals. This wiki aims to document the current state of the institute (as of 2026) for the benefit of students and the broader community. Beyond a few outdated Facebook groups, Quora threads, and unmaintained notes, reliable information on the web is scarce -- and this wiki changes that!

Getting Started

  • How are the hostels?
  • How is my department?
  • What will my student life look like?
  • How is the campus?
  • Show me some photos!
  • Search the entire wiki.

Community

We have maintained two vibrant and active communities since November 2025. Everyone is welcome to join the conversation on our subreddit. We also have a Discord Server, which requires a quick verification process to enter.

pages.title: Hostels
pages.lede: A practical index for hostel life, room types, food, cleanliness, rules, eligibility, and photos.
pages.html:
What are the Hostels for first year students?

There are ...

Food

  • Mess fees = 27.7k (Pay through this portal : - )

Room Types

  • 4 seater : currently the 1st year hostels are majorly 4 seatered, space is an issue, but fun to live if you get the right roomates.
  • 5 Seater : In each boys hostel, "4"-5 seater room are there, the room is bigger than hte 4 seaters and has an attached balcony.
  • 8 seater: Only in H-10, "2"-8 seater rooms are there.

1000 Seater

  • Opens on 16th August,2026

Halls And New Hostels

  • Currently we have 5 HALLS for boys and 2 Halls for girls.
  • Halls for boys are - wolfenden, Richardson, MacDonalds, Sen, Sengupta
  • Halls for Girls are - Pandya and Lt. William.
  • The boys halls are generally for the 4th years, few 3rd years also stay and the college-senate position holders are also the residents of the halls.
  • The boys halls are generally 1 or 2 seaters.

Hygiene And Cleanliness

  • Bathrooms are cleaned everyday.
  • Filter drinking water are available
  • Waste disposal points are there
  • Mess is clean.
  • Rooms are to be cleaned by the individuals living in them, though the staff would assist you if you ask them to.

In-time

  • for the first two months, irrespective of gender, your hostel intime is 7PM
  • The intime gets extended to 10PM afterwards for the rest of the year.

Electronics Usability

  • You can actually bring anything you want.
  • you get 4 sockets per room.
  • always take one extension cord, it's beneficial.

Do not publish advice that bypasses electrical safety rules.

Home Distance Eligibility

  • Previously in round-1 of hostel allotments : - 150kms was the minimum limit to get hostel accomodations.

Photos

  • Prefer natural light and uncropped context.
  • Blur faces or avoid people entirely.
  • Add hall name, room type, and month/year.
  • Include both good and bad conditions.

pages.title: Soft Ragging And Intro
pages.lede: What to do when intro culture becomes coercive, humiliating, or unsafe.
pages.html:
Immediate Steps

  • Leave the situation if possible.
  • Preserve messages, call logs, photos, and dates.
  • Contact trusted seniors, faculty, hostel authorities, or anti-ragging channels.
  • Add official anti-ragging links here and verify them every semester.

Avoid publishing names on the wiki. This page should guide action, not run public trials.

pages.title: About
pages.lede: Who keeps Shibpur Wiki running.
pages.html:
Shibpur Wiki is a small student-run effort to keep useful IIEST Shibpur information in one place.

It is not an official institute website. It is a place for notes, links, corrections, and lived student knowledge that would otherwise stay scattered in chats.

People

  • Sagnik - started the wiki.
  • More contributors to be added.

How To Help

  • Add missing links.
  • Fix outdated claims.
  • Add dates to rules, fees, contacts, and notices.
  • Share photos only when they are useful and safe to publish.
  • Keep private student information private.

pages.title: Contribute
pages.lede: How maintainers can add or update pages without touching the site generator.
pages.html:
Edit files inside src/content/pages. Each file is Markdown with a small metadata block at the top.

Page Template

Use this shape for new pages:

---
title: Page title
summary: One sentence summary.
order: 50
---
Intro paragraph.
## Links
- [Useful link](https://example.com)
## Needs Verification
- Add pending claims here.

Writing Standard

  • Prefer links over long explanations.
  • Add dates for fees, rules, placements, availability, and office timings.
  • Separate official rules from student reports.
  • Keep allegations careful, specific, and actionable.
  • Avoid naming private students without consent.

Photos In Pages

Put downloaded photos inside src/assets/photos. The build copies that folder to /assets/photos.

Use this in the middle of any Markdown page:

Text before the photo.
![Clock Tower sample](/assets/photos/sample-campus.jpg)
Text after the photo.

Text before the photo.

Text after the photo.
